stories.originalTitle: Use Kimi Code CLI with models on Amazon Bedrock

points: Kimi Code CLI is an open source coding agent from Moonshot AI, the creator of the Kimi series of open-weight foundation models.
Previously, using Kimi Code with models on Amazon Bedrock meant configuring a generic connection “provider” with an Amazon Bedrock API key.
For many AWS customers, this meant introducing an extra credential to obtain and protect.
